notes.title: Early Access Available Now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=3OrfV782t4Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Theiaology started as a dare to myself to render as many voxels as possible with consistent FPS on the Oculus Quest in VR. Add on the FATE timeline script, Steam Workshop integration, Phony VR hands for all platforms and here we are today. 

I hope you enjoy exploring YGGDRASIL and the demos it has to offer. Please share your creations on the Steam Workshop or by uploading to a special GitHub repository called 'theiaology.com'. You can link directly to your creations uploaded to GitHub with the following format, https://theiaology.com/githubuser/filename replacing githubuser with your user name and filename with the name of the fate file you wish to link.

ex: [url=https://theiaology.com/agoblinking/overworld]https://theiaology.com/agoblinking/overworld[/url]
and https://github.com/agoblinking/theiaology.com

Have fun!


psst! Theiaology is open source so write up issues or contribute at https://github.com/agoblinking/theiaology

Time Formating on LISP script is now h : m : s
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252395/78ca9b50fb83d8986957b95c4e3a0c1457349029.png[/img]
